How sure an AI result is: five pips plus words ("High confidence"), so it never relies on colour alone.

## Notes

How sure an AI result is: five pips plus words, never colour alone.

## Props (ConfidenceMeterProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | Score from 0 to 1. Sets the level (0.8+ high, 0.5+ medium) unless `level` is given. |
| `level` | `'high' \| 'medium' \| 'low'` | Explicit level. Overrides `value` for the pips and words. |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Replaces the default words ("High confidence"). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | Show the percentage after the words. @default false |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | @default "md" |
| `onInk` | `boolean` | White pips and text for navy panels. @default false |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>._
